leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a custom useFetch hook that manages API request states
Initialize state variables to track loading, error, and data from API responses
Apply the useEffect hook to trigger API calls when dependencies change
Construct proper error handling for failed network requests
Manipulate component state to update UI based on API response status
Integrate the useFetch hook into functional components to fetch and display data
Configure dependency arrays to control when the hook re-fetches data
